an10.101:1.1: CI. Tisso bhikkhave samaṇasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta dhamme paripūrenti. Katamā tisso? Vevaṇṇiyamhi ajjhūpagato, parapaṭibaddhā me jīvikā, añño me ākappo karaṇīyo ti. Imā kho bhikkhave tisso samaṇasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta dhamme paripūrenti.
an10.101:2.1: Katame satta? Niccaṃ satatakārī hoti satatavuttī sīlesu, anabhijjhālu hoti, avyāpajjho hoti, anatimānī hoti, sikkhākāmo hoti, idam atthan ti 'ssa hoti jīvitaparikkhāresu, āraddhaviriyo ca viharati. Imā kho bhikkhave tisso samaṇasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ime satta dhamme paripūrentī ti.
